underflag_reexam.closest_named_thing: arXiv:2602.00906 'Hallucination is a Consequence of Space-Optimality: A Rate-Distortion Theorem for Membership Testing' (Guo & Li, Feb 2026)
underflag_reexam.reasoning: Decisive contrast confirmed from the paper's own abstract: 2602.00906 is an information-theoretic IMPOSSIBILITY / rate-distortion LOWER BOUND, and its central conclusion runs OPPOSITE to M056. Verbatim from the abstract: 'the information-theoretically optimal strategy under limited capacity is not to abstain or forget, but to assign high confidence to some non-facts, resulting in hallucination.' It proposes NO activation-based membership sketch, NO abstention primitive, and NO familiarity-vs-retrievability typology. M056 instead BUILDS an activation-hashed one-sided (no-false-negative) ABSTENTION primitive plus a 2x2 TOT/deja-vu recall-state typology -- i.e. it constructs the abstention mechanism the paper argues is sub-optimal, and adds a cognitive decomposition absent from the paper. Shared Bloom<->LLM framing is genuine adjacency, not verbatim equivalence. Genuine merge near prior work.

underflag_reexam.closest_named_thing: Git Re-Basin (arXiv:2209.04836); REPAIR (2211.08403); neuron-alignment mode connectivity (2009.02439)
underflag_reexam.reasoning: Git Re-Basin (verified) permutes units to align two models then merges in weight space; it computes the alignment via an assignment/matching problem solved SEPARATELY, then measures the static barrier. M008's load-bearing object is the inverse: recover the aligning permutation as a free by-product of a budgeted ridge-CLIMB ('moss-compass' per-parameter gradient-orientation accumulator) plus a motion-aware dynamic barrier S* > static saddle. No named method decodes the permutation from a climb log or defines a budget-action barrier. Strong adjacency, distinct mechanism.

underflag_reexam.closest_named_thing: MoTHer / Unsupervised Model Tree Heritage Recovery (arXiv:2405.18432); GhostSpec / 'Ghost in the Transformer' (arXiv:2511.06390)
underflag_reexam.reasoning: Both neighbors verified and are real and close: MoTHer reconstructs model lineage trees from weight distances (weight-distance correlates with tree node-distance); GhostSpec builds permutation-invariant SVD spectral fingerprints of attention matrix products for data-free lineage/reuse detection. M019 reuses exactly these two ingredients (invariant spectra + lineage), so this is the closest-to-prior-work case. BUT neither named work makes M019's load-bearing dual claim: that the alignment-free invariant distance PREDICTS the post-alignment mode-connectivity BARRIER height (mergeability/soup-compatibility) before any permutation search. Lineage recovery != barrier prediction. The 'provenance-distance = mergeability-distance' equation is assembled across two separate literatures, not lifted from either. Adjacency is high but it is not verbatim equivalence; confirm PASS with medium risk flagged for transparency.

underflag_reexam.closest_named_thing: StreamingLLM 'Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks' (arXiv:2309.17453, Xiao et al., ICLR 2024)
underflag_reexam.reasoning: StreamingLLM (verified) establishes the attention-sink phenomenon and proposes keeping ~4 initial sink tokens' KV to stabilize streaming perplexity -- a fixed few-token engineering fix. M027's load-bearing objects are different: a concave monotone sink-MASS accumulation LAW M(L) vs context length, its slope dM/dL as a per-head under-specialization/key-miss metric, and a rank-sized MULTI-slot sink pinned to the effective rank of the unmatched-query covariance. None of these (growth law, slope-as-metric, rank-sized multi-slot) appears in StreamingLLM or the cited softmax-flattening fixes. Distinct construct; adjacency only.

underflag_reexam.closest_named_thing: PURM / Probabilistic Uncertain Reward Model (arXiv:2503.22480); BNRM / Bayesian Non-negative Reward Modeling (arXiv:2602.10623)
underflag_reexam.reasoning: Both neighbors verified. PURM generalizes Bradley-Terry to learn reward DISTRIBUTIONS and quantifies per-sample uncertainty via Bhattacharyya overlap to curb reward hacking; BNRM uses Bayesian non-negative factor analysis to suppress spurious correlations / over-optimization. Both are PASSIVE, single-agent uncertainty-aware estimators. M032's load-bearing content is a ROLE_EXCHANGE: the reward model becomes an ACTIVE haggler that probes the policy's max-uncertainty skill and treats Kalman gain as a concession, with covariance-collapse-while-reward-rising as an over-optimization alarm. The active-probing/bargaining inversion + Kalman-concession-theorem is in neither named RM. Conceptual adjacency on the uncertainty axis only; distinct mechanism. (Top-ranked construct -- adjacency correctly disregarded in ranking.)

underflag_reexam.closest_named_thing: Neural Persistence (arXiv:1812.09764, Rieck et al., ICLR 2019); filtration-learning TDA on nets
underflag_reexam.reasoning: Neural Persistence (verified) is a topological COMPLEXITY MEASURE computed on a single network's weighted stratified graph (static representation shape), used e.g. as an early-stopping criterion. M057's load-bearing move is orthogonal: use the CHECKPOINT-TIMELINE INDEX as the filtration axis so the persistence barcode DATES when a capability/backdoor entered a lineage (birth coordinate = training step entered; persistence = how load-bearing), yielding a birth-vs-persistence forensic plane and a 'load-bearing-yet-young' backdoor signature. No named TDA-on-nets work treats the training timeline as the filtration to date feature insertion. Same tool, distinct application; not regurgitation.

citation_verification.cited_for: M056 (Bloom<->LLM membership-error unification; nearest prior work)
citation_verification.what_it_says: Rate-distortion / impossibility theorem: formalizes fact memorization as membership testing unifying Bloom-filter discrete error with LLM log-loss; under limited capacity the optimal strategy is NOT to abstain but to assign high confidence to some non-facts (hallucinate).
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: 'the information-theoretically optimal strategy under limited capacity is not to abstain or forget, but to assign high confidence to some non-facts, resulting in hallucination' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.00906)

citation_verification.what_it_says: 'Mitigating Reward Hacking in RLHF via Bayesian Non-negative Reward Modeling' (BNRM): Bayesian non-negative factor analysis in a Bradley-Terry model; sparsity debiases spurious correlations and reduces reward over-optimization.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: Title verified: 'Mitigating Reward Hacking in RLHF via Bayesian Non-negative Reward Modeling' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10623)

citation_verification.what_it_says: 'Three Phases of Expert Routing': models MoE routing as a congestion game with one congestion coefficient; tracks a non-monotone surge/stabilization/relaxation balance trajectory across training. No spin-glass frustration or aging two-time correlator.

STARS: 'Exploring Diverse Generation Paths via Inference-time Stiefel Activation Steering' -- training-free one-step orthogonal (Stiefel-manifold) steering update maximizing activation volume for diversity. Not a stateful self-cancelling feedback loop.

'Not All Layers Need Tuning: Selective Layer Restoration Recovers Diversity' -- restoring a chosen layer range to pre-trained weights recovers generation diversity (localizes mode collapse to layers).

'When Are Experts Misrouted? Counterfactual Routing Analysis in MoE LMs' -- on fragile/low-confidence tokens the standard route is best on only 0.8% of tokens; best equal-compute alternative gains 20.4pp; misrouting concentrates on low-confidence tokens.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: 'on fragile tokens this alignment collapses: the standard route is best on only 0.8% of tokens' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07260)

citation_verification.what_it_says: PURM: 'Probabilistic Uncertain Reward Model' -- generalizes Bradley-Terry to learn reward distributions; per-sample uncertainty via Bhattacharyya-coefficient distribution overlap; sustains more RLHF steps before reward hacking.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: 'quantifies per-sample uncertainty via the average overlap area between reward distributions' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.22480)

citation_verification.what_it_says: MoTHer / 'Unsupervised Model Tree Heritage Recovery' (a.k.a. On the Origin of Llamas) -- reconstructs model trees; weight distance correlates with tree node distance; weight-outlier count rises in generalization, falls in fine-tuning.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: 'the distance between weights of model pairs correlates with their node distance on the Model Tree' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.18432)

citation_verification.cited_for: M019 (permutation-invariant spectral fingerprint for model reuse)
citation_verification.what_it_says: 'Ghost in the Transformer: Detecting Model Reuse with Invariant Spectral Signatures' (GhostSpec) -- SVD of invariant attention weight-matrix products (QK, VO) gives data-free fingerprints robust to fine-tuning/pruning for lineage detection.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: 'applies singular value decomposition (SVD) to invariant products of internal attention weight matrices' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.06390)

citation_verification.cited_for: M023 (entropy-based early draft stopping in spec decoding)
citation_verification.what_it_says: AdaEDL -- training/parameter-free early draft stopping using an entropy-based lower bound on token acceptance probability; outperforms static draft-length spec decoding by 10-57%.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: 'approximating a lower bound on the expected acceptance probability of the drafted token based on the currently observed entropy of the drafted logits' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.18351)

citation_verification.what_it_says: 'LLMs Can Covertly Sandbag on Capability Evaluations Against Chain-of-Thought Monitoring' -- models can strategically underperform on dangerous-capability evals (WMDP/MMLU) while evading CoT monitors. Uses prompting/CoT monitoring, not vector-clock causal ordering.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: Title verified; 'Sandbagging is the strategic underperformance on evaluations' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.00943)

citation_verification.what_it_says: 'Measuring and Guiding Monosemanticity' -- introduces FMS (Feature Monosemanticity Score) quantifying feature monosemanticity/localization, plus Guided SAEs. Score is classifier/dimension-based, not a relational gossip-reputation fixed point.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: 'introduces FMS (Feature Monosemanticity Score), a general score to systematically quantify feature monosemanticity' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.19382)

citation_verification.cited_for: M008 / M019 (mode connectivity via permutation alignment; classic)
citation_verification.what_it_says: Git Re-Basin: 'Merging Models modulo Permutation Symmetries' -- permutes one model's units to align with a reference, enabling weight-space merge into an approximately convex shared basin. Solves alignment separately, then merges.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: 'three algorithms to permute the units of one model to bring them into alignment with a reference model in order to merge the two models in weight space' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.04836)

citation_verification.what_it_says: Model Soups: averaging weights of multiple fine-tuned models improves accuracy/robustness without extra inference cost. No fluctuation-dissipation / FDT weighting.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: 'averaging the weights of multiple models fine-tuned with different hyperparameter configurations often improves accuracy and robustness' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.05482)

citation_verification.what_it_says: 'An Empirical Model of Large-Batch Training' (McCandlish, Kaplan et al.) -- the gradient noise scale predicts the largest useful (critical) batch size across many domains. Treats GNS as one global scalar, not a per-concept bloom-crash trajectory.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: 'a simple and easy-to-measure statistic called the gradient noise scale predicts the largest useful batch size' (https://arxiv.org/abs/1812.06162)

citation_verification.what_it_says: 'Neural Persistence: A Complexity Measure for Deep Neural Networks Using Algebraic Topology' (Rieck et al., ICLR 2019) -- TDA-based static complexity measure on a network's weighted graph; yields an early-stopping criterion. Static shape, not checkpoint-timeline dating.
citation_verification.quote_if_seen: 'a complexity measure for neural network architectures based on topological data analysis on weighted stratified graphs' (https://arxiv.org/abs/1812.09764)

Highest residual adjacency is M019 vs MoTHer+GhostSpec (medium risk) but the barrier-prediction claim is genuinely additional. CITATIONS: all 12 high-priority IDs and all 4 known-classic IDs verified to exist and to match what the checker cited them for; ZERO hallucinated arXiv ids. Both arxiv IDs that the checker treated as M056's twin and the top-5 load-bearing neighbors are real. Checker neither over- nor under-flagged.
